STAT5 proteins may play an important role in the pathobiology of cutaneous T-Cell lymphoma cells.
STAT5 proteins play a significant role not only in leukaemia and in the process of apoptosis, but also in the proliferation and in the process apoptosis of human cutaneous T cell lymphoma cell lines.

the role of STAT5s in the proliferation and the process of apoptosys in human T-cell lymphoma.
the role of STAT5 in the growth and apoptosis of selected cell lines.

STAT5 is an important regulator of the growth of cutaneus T-cell lymphoma.

the antisense oligodeoxy-nucleotides (AS ODN) against the STAT5 proteins may be a promising tool in the treatment of cutaneous T cell lymphomas.

the inhibition of STAT5 may have a significant impact on the treatment of cutaneous T cell lymphoma.
